description: Lynia Finance - Fineract Chart of Accounts for Microfinance Lending
notes: GL accounts follow standard microfinance chart of accounts structure.
Accounts are created once during initial Fineract setup.
Financial activity mappings connect Fineract loan events to GL entries.

accounts.name: Assets
accounts.description: Header account for all asset accounts

accounts.name: Cash and Bank
accounts.description: Cash on hand and bank balances. Fund source for loan disbursements.

accounts.name: Loan Portfolio
accounts.description: Outstanding loan principal balances. Debited on disbursement, credited on repayment.

accounts.name: Interest Receivable
accounts.description: Accrued interest not yet collected. Used with accrual-based accounting.

accounts.name: Fee Receivable
accounts.description: Accrued fees not yet collected (disbursement fees, processing fees).

accounts.name: Penalty Receivable
accounts.description: Accrued penalty charges not yet collected (late payment penalties).

accounts.name: Liabilities
accounts.description: Header account for all liability accounts

accounts.name: Overpayment Liability
accounts.description: Customer overpayments held pending refund or application to next installment.

accounts.name: Transfers in Suspense
accounts.description: Temporary holding account for funds in transit between accounts.

accounts.name: Opening Balance Equity
accounts.description: Used for initial balance adjustments during setup.

accounts.name: Income
accounts.description: Header account for all income accounts

accounts.name: Interest Income
accounts.description: Interest earned on outstanding loans. Credited when interest is recognized.

accounts.name: Income from Recovery
accounts.description: Income from recovery of previously written-off loans.

accounts.name: Expenses
accounts.description: Header account for all expense accounts

accounts.name: Loan Write-Off Expense
accounts.description: Expense recognized when loans are written off as uncollectable.

accounts.name: Provision Expense
accounts.description: Expense for loan loss provisioning per RBZ guidelines.

loanProductAccountMappings.description: Maps loan product financial events to GL accounts. Applied to all 3 loan products.
